# Binder OS

> Binder OS is the Textile Manufacturing Operating System — "your company's
> nervous system." One system of record for complete traceability of operations,
> from raw material to finished goods, built for India's textile ecosystem.
> A product of Binder 33 Labs (https://binder33labs.com).

Binder OS (https://binder-os.binder33labs.com) replaces the chaos of spreadsheets, WhatsApp
groups, and disconnected registers with a single manufacturing operating system.
It starts where every company starts — with inventory.

## It all starts with inventory

The foundation is a complete Inventory Management System. It is not a standalone
module bolted on later: production planning reads from it, job orders dispatch
against it, challans reference it, and traceability traces back to it.

- Real-time stock visibility — raw materials, WIP, and finished goods across
  every location and department.
- Unit-level traceability — every unit gets a unique identification number (UIN)
  that follows it from intake to dispatch, even across company boundaries.
- Inward & outward registers — digital replacements for the paper registers,
  linked to challans, purchase orders, and job orders automatically.
- Multi-unit, multi-location — departments, warehouses, and branch units in one
  view.

## From inventory to full operations

- Job Order Management — create, dispatch, and track job orders to external job
  workers; every unit carries its UIN reference, and inventory automatically
  adjusts on dispatch and receipt.
- Delivery Challans & Documentation — challans linked to actual inventory
  records, not typed from memory, with full traceability back to the source
  material.
- Quality & Compliance — quality reports attached to specific units and batches:
  GSM, EPI, PPI, AQL results, and defect records for any piece of inventory.
- Operational Intelligence — every challan, job order, and quality check feeds a
  growing body of operational data unique to the company.

## The COO Agent

"Your AI Operations Manager — Always On." An AI assistant that lives across the
entire Binder OS — inventory, job orders, production, quality — and works inside
the team's existing Telegram groups. No new app, no login portal. It answers
natural-language questions ("What's the current stock of 200 GSM polyester?"),
sends proactive alerts (low stock, overdue job orders, quality threshold
breaches), relays messages and follows up with team members, and automatically
expands its scope as more departments come onboard.

## Who it is for

Built for the textile ecosystem: vertically integrated companies (end-to-end
operations under one system), exporters and manufacturers (the traceability
international buyers demand — every unit documented from raw material to
container), and job workers (their own system: track incoming orders, manage
inventory and production, build a verifiable work history).

## Roadmap

- Production Layer — full production process management: define sequences, track
  work-in-progress across departments and machines, connect every step back to
  inventory and job orders. The COO Agent will extend into production monitoring
  automatically.
- Binder Lite — a standalone product for job workers, independently useful from
  day one, with no dependency on a parent company's onboarding.

## Getting started

There is no public pricing; the conversion path is a demo / early access.
Binder OS is currently onboarding textile manufacturers in the Panipat
ecosystem, expanding soon. Onboarding is a 4-step setup measured in minutes, not
months — no consultants needed. Request a demo or early access at
https://binder-os.binder33labs.com/.
